hooks.command: sh -c 'unset IFS; set -f; umask 077; [ -n "$AOE_INSTANCE_ID" ] || exit 0; case "$AOE_INSTANCE_ID" in *[!0-9a-zA-Z_-]*) exit 0 ;; esac; B=/tmp/aoe-hooks-501; mkdir -p "$B" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; LS=$(LC_ALL=C ls -ldn "$B" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; set -- $LS; M="$1"; case "$M" in drwx------|drwx------.|drwx------+|drwx------@) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; ME=$(id -u 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ "$3" = "$ME" ] || exit 0; D="$B/$AOE_INSTANCE_ID"; mkdir -p "$D" 2>/dev/null; LS=$(LC_ALL=C ls -ldn "$D" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; set -- $LS; M="$1"; case "$M" in drwx------|drwx------.|drwx------+|drwx------@) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ "$3" = "$ME" ] || exit 0; printf running > "$D/status" 2>/dev/null; exit 0 # aoe-hooks'

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(sh|bash|zsh)$' || head -1 "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^#!.*\b(bash|sh|zsh)\b'; then shellcheck "$f"; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.claude/settings\.json$' || exit 0; tmp=$(mktemp); jq 'del(.model) | .permissions.allow |= sort' "$f" > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
